title: The whole book again in Beriya, Yetzira and Asiya: thought, speech and action
overview:
The chapter goes down through *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, and says that the whole thing repeats in each. *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* becomes the *Keser* of *Beriya*, the will for creation; from it come *Abba* and *Ima*, *Zeir Anpin* and *Malchus* of *Beriya*, its lights, vessels and *heichalos*. That, says Rabbi Markel, is the whole book, chapters 1 through 51, all over again.

The *Kesarim* have no real chain of descent: a *Keser* is always a *Keser*, and the will for the last deed is as strong as the will to emanate, maybe stronger, because the dwelling below is what He really wanted. That is why it is called *Keser Malchus*. Between the worlds there is a screen. *Beriya* is like thought, a *yesh* still hidden inside the person; *Yetzira* is like speech, half in and half out; *Asiya* is like the deed, totally separate. Each has its *chachma*, *bina* and angels, the same existence but not the same essence, as a man's essence, thought, speech and deed each have their own wisdom. The last lines of the chapter are not on tape.

terms.gloss: the will to emanate: a man figuring out in his own mind what he wants for the house
the crown of kingship: the Keser of Beriya, called so davka because it is the will for the end of the deed
a screen; between Atzilus and the Essence there is none, only tzimtzum, but between the worlds there is an actual masach
a partition, between the end of the deed of the will for Beriya and the beginning of the will for Yetzira
hidden worlds: Beriya, like thought, already a yesh but hidden inside the person
the inside of the vessels, from which the souls come (the angels come from chitzoniyus hakelim, the outside)
the higher mother nests in the Throne: the bina of Atzilus in Beriya, as a man's bina is in his thought
the angels of Beriya, from the outside of its vessels
the prince of the world of Beriya, the vessels of its Zeir Anpin, with the Havaya of Zeir Anpin of Atzilus inside him
the lad: Metatron, the little face beside Zeir Anpin of Atzilus, which here is the big face
the main angel of Yetzira in this chapter; other places put him in Asiya

sections.title: The Keser of Beriya: the last of Atzilus becomes the will to create, and a Keser is always a Keser
sections.summary: *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* becomes the *Keser* of *Beriya*, the will for creation. It comes from the lowest level of the world above, yet in the *Kesarim* there is no real chain of descent: the will for the final deed is as connected to the Essence as the will to emanate, and in a way higher.

phrases.he: (נב) והנה בבחינת פרטות דעשר ספירות דמלכות דאצילות בבריאה אחר בקיעת המסך,
הרי ידוע שבחינת כתר מלכות דבריאה הנקרא עתיק דבריאה, הוא שנמשך מבחינת מלכות דמלכות דאצילות כו',
היינו בחינת הרצון והתענוג לבחינת מקור לבריאה יש מאין ממש
כמאמר כד סליק ברעותא למיברי עלמא,
דכמו שעלה ברצונו להאציל כו' כך ירד הרצון לברוא
phrases.en: There was a *ratzon l'ha'atzil*, then there was a *ratzon* for the *Beriya*.

phrases.he: יש מאין כו' והוא הנקרא כתר מלכות דבריאה

blocks.text: *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* **becomes *Keser* of *Beriya***: as **there was a *ratzon l'ha'atzil*** (will to emanate), **then there was a *ratzon* for the *Beriya***.

blocks.title: The house and the architect
blocks.text: Emanating is the man working out what he wants for his house; *Beriya* is the will for its original concept, as with an architect.

There is no real *hishtalshelus* (chain of descent) in the *Kesarim* (crowns): *Keser* of *Beriya* is already in *Adam Kadmon*, even in the *ratzon hapashut* (simple will). Coming from *Malchus* of *Atzilus*, it is still a *Keser*.

The will to go to the architect comes at the end of the man's own planning, as *Keser* of *Beriya* comes from *Malchus* of *Atzilus*. Yet the will for *Beriya*, down to *Asiya*, is as strong and as connected to the Essence as the will for *Atzilus*, and the will for the final deed is in a way higher: what He really wanted was a *dira b'tachtonim* (dwelling below).

blocks.title: The architect, the draftsman and the contractor
blocks.text: He goes to the contractor only after the architect; from the architect's deed comes the will for the draftsman's drawing (*Yetzira*), and from that the will to build. Yet the will to build equals the first will, maybe more: "wow, we're *mamash* building now." The finished building, *Malchus* of *Malchus*, is the real will.
So it is called *Keser Malchus* (the crown of kingship), *davka*: the *Keser* is the will for the end of the deed, the *Malchus*.

phrases.he: (כמו שמבואר במקום אחר בענין ישמעאל בני ברכני, אמר לו יהי רצון מלפניך כו'
פירוש רבי ישמעאל כהן גדול היה בהיכל קודש קדשים דבריאה, ששם יורד אור מלכות דמלכות דאצילות להיות כתר לבריאה,
phrases.en: Even though he was in the *Kodesh HaKodashim* of *Beriya*, this was nonetheless from *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* becoming *Keser* of *Beriya*.

phrases.he: על כן אמר לו בני ברכני,
phrases.en: And that's why he said to him, help me come down.

phrases.he: ואמר לו יהי רצון מלפניך כו')

blocks.text: Rabbi Yishmael the High Priest, in the *Kodesh HaKodashim* (Holy of Holies) of *Beriya*, met *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Atzilus* becoming *Keser* of *Beriya*. So G-d said, "Bless me": **help me come down**, properly; and he answered, "May it be Your will that Your mercy overcome Your attributes," something like that.

sections.title: From the will down to the heichalos of Beriya: the whole book all over again
sections.summary: From the will for *Beriya* come its *Abba* and *Ima*, its *Zeir Anpin* and its *Malchus*, which brings about the souls and angels, with lights, vessels, garments and *heichalos*. All of chapters 1 to 51 was these few lines: to know how it works in *Beriya*, go back and see how it worked above.

phrases.he: ומבחינת התענוג והרצון הזה להיות הבריאה כו',
נמשך בחכמה ובינה דרצון ותענוג הזה, ונקרא אבא ואמא דבריאה
ומאבא ואמא שהוא בחינת חכמה ובינה של זה הרצון והתענוג, נמשכו בחינת המדות שנקרא זעיר אנפין דבריאה
ומזעיר אנפין למלכות דבריאה,
שהוא מקור המהוה עולם הבריאה, נשמות ומלאכים מאין ליש ממש כו'
ויש בעשר ספירות דבריאה גם כן בחינת אורות וכלים ולבושים והיכלות
וכידוע בענין ז' היכלות דבריאה, ובהיכל קודש קדשים שהוא היכל הז',
שם יחוד דזעיר אנפין ונוקבה כו'

blocks.outOfPlace: From his first quick reading of lines 1-8, where he stops and sums up the chapter before going back to its beginning.
blocks.text: This chapter goes through *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, the whole thing repeating in each: the will down to the *Avos* and to *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*, three ways, *Chabad*, *Chagas* and *Nehi*, from the inside, the union to give birth *davka* the inner one. The whole book, chapters 1 to 51, down to weeping and joy as two sides of one thing, was these few lines.

From the will come *chachma* and *bina* of *Beriya*, its *Zeir Anpin* and its *Malchus*, which brings about the *heichalos* (chambers), with the union in the seventh, the *Kodesh HaKodashim*. It is the whole book again: the text says *Abba*, *Zeir Anpin*, *Malchus*, "blah blah blah, poof, finished!" Go back: the union works here as it did there.

sections.title: A screen between Beriya and Yetzira
sections.summary: *Malchus* of *Beriya* becomes the *Keser* of *Yetzira* through a screen, as between *Atzilus* and *Beriya*. The *Keser* of each world is still connected to the Essence; but where *Atzilus* has only a *tzimtzum* from the Essence, the worlds below need an actual screen.

phrases.he: ומבחינת מלכות דבריאה נעשה בחינת כתר ועתיק יומין דעולם היצירה,
גם כן על ידי בקיעת מסך שבין בריאה ליצירה,
על דרך הנזכר לעיל במסך שבין אצילות לבריאה
דכמו שעלה ברצונו לברוא, כך עלה ברצונו ליצירה ועשיה,
רק שצריך להיות הפסק פרסא בין סוף מעשה דרצון דבריאה, לתחלת הרצון דיצירה כו'
וכמו שכתוב לכבודי בראתיו יצרתיו אף עשיתיו

blocks.text: *Malchus* of *Beriya* becomes *Keser* of *Yetzira*, and **here's also a *masach*** (screen): as He willed to create, so to form and make. Each *Keser* comes from the *Malchus* before it, yet is connected to the Essence, the *ratzon hapashut*.
Only a *parsa* (partition) must divide them: between *Atzilus* and the Essence there is just a *tzimtzum*, below it an actual *masach*, and so between *Beriya* and *Yetzira*.

sections.title: Thought, speech and action: the separate worlds, their souls and their angels
sections.summary: *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are separate worlds as thought, speech and deed are: thought a *yesh* still hidden inside, speech half in and half out, the deed totally separate. In *Beriya* the souls come from the inside of the vessels and the angels from the outside, the *bina* of *Atzilus* nests there as a man's *bina* is in his thought, and *Metatron* carries the Name of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus*.

phrases.he: וידוע דבי"ע הנקרא ג' עולמות הנפרדים מאין ליש ממש
היינו כדוגמת התהוות אותיות המחשבה ודבור ומעשה שבאים בבחינת יש נפרד לעצמו ממש

blocks.text: *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are the three separate worlds, each a *yesh* (something), like letters of thought, speech and deed: *Beriya*, like thought, a *yesh* inside the person; *Yetzira*, like speech, half in and half out; *Asiya*, the deed, totally separate.

phrases.he: כך מבחינת אותיות המחשבה דמדות דאלהי״ם דבריאה, הנקרא זעיר אנפין דבריאה כנזכר לעיל,
נבראו מזה בחינת עלמין סתימין דלא אתגליין, שהן נשמות ומלאכים דעולם הבריאה מאין ליש ממש

blocks.text: From the letters of thought of the *middos* of *Beriya* come the *almin stimin* (hidden worlds), its souls and angels: separate, but hidden like thought, a *yesh* inside the person.

phrases.he: כמו נשמת אברהם אוהבי מבחינת פנימיות הכלים דחסד דזעיר אנפין שבמלכות דבריאה,
ומיכאל דעולם הבריאה מבחינת חיצוניות הכלים ואותיות דחסד דזעיר אנפין דבריאה כו'

blocks.text: Souls come from the *pnimiyus hakelim* (inside of the vessels), angels from the outside: *Avraham*'s soul from the inside of the vessels of *chesed*, Michael, its angel, from the outside.

phrases.he: וכן גן עדן העליון דבריאה,
היינו מבחינת אור הכתר דבריאה,
שהוא התענוג העליון שנקרא עתיק דבריאה, שמתצמצם בבינה שבמלכות דבריאה, שהנשמות דבריאה נהנין מזיו כו'

blocks.text: The souls of *Beriya* enjoy the delight of its *Keser* contracted into the *bina* in its *Malchus*: *bina* in speech, as we now receive *bina* from letters of speech, hidden in them, not directly.

phrases.he: (וכידוע דאימא עילאה מקננא בכורסייא, שהוא אור בינה דאצילות, על ידי השתלשלות רבות עד בינה דמלכות דאצילות בבינה שבמלכות דבריאה כו',
ועל דרך זה זעיר אנפין דאצילות מקנן ביצירה ומלכות בעשיה כו')

blocks.text: *Ima ila'a mekanena b'kursaya* (the higher mother nests in the Throne): *bina* of *Atzilus* is in *Beriya*, *Zeir Anpin* in *Yetzira*, *Malchus* in *Asiya*, the four letters of *Havaya*, though all four are in *Atzilus*. So a man's *bina* is in his thought, his inner emotions in his actual heart, his inner *Malchus* in the deed.

phrases.he: וכך הוא ענין השרפים, שהם בעולם הבריאה כו',
והן בני האלהי״ם שמתייצבים על יהו״ה שהוא בחינת זעיר אנפין דבריאה
ובחינת כלים דזעיר אנפין דבריאה, הוא בחינת מטטרו״ן, שרו של עולם הבריאה,
שנאמר בו כי שמי בקרבו, שהוא יהו״ה דזעיר אנפין דאצילות כו'
phrases.en: *Havaya* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus* is inside of the *sar* of *Olam HaBeriya*.

blocks.text: The *Serafim*, angels, are from the outside of the vessels of *Beriya*; its vessels are *Metatron*, "My Name is within him": ***Havaya* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus* is inside of the *sar* of *Olam HaBeriya***, in separate vessels, as emotion is inside thought.

phrases.he: (ונקרא נער אנפי זוטרי לגבי בחינת אנפי רברבי בחינת זעיר אנפין דאצילות כידוע)
phrases.en: Here he calls *Zeir Anpin* the big face, and he's calling *Metatron* the little face.

blocks.text: *Metatron* is called the *na'ar* (lad): **he's calling *Metatron* the little face**, beside the big face, *Zeir Anpin* of *Atzilus*, which is little only beside *Arich*.

sections.title: Beriya the world of thought, Yetzira the world of speech
sections.summary: *Beriya* is the world of thought, hidden worlds, still connected to the essence of the intellect: the *yud* of the Name, through which the World to Come was created. *Yetzira* is the world of speech, revealed worlds, half in and half out. *Serafim*, *Chayos* and *Ofanim* are in every world, but in general they are of *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*.

phrases.he: ובכלל נקרא עולם הבריאה עולם המחשבה, בחינת עלמין סתימין כו'
(כמו ביו"ד נברא העולם הבא, שהוא יו"ד דמחשבה דבינה דמלכות דבריאה כו',
ובה' נברא העולם הזה בחינת היצירה והעשיה)

blocks.text: *Beriya* is the world of thought. With the *yud* the World to Come was created, with the *heh* this world: the Name divides into *yud-heh* and *vav-heh*. *Beriya*, from the *yud*, is like thought, still connected to the essence of the intellect.

blocks.question: Doesn't thought come out of *bina*?
blocks.text: A different aspect: here thought is what is connected to the self. (He breaks off there.)

phrases.he: ועולם היצירה, עולם הדבור,
עלמין דאתגליין כו'
(וכמו נבואות ישעיהו בשרפים דבריאה שאומרים קדוש, ויחזקאל בחיות ואופנים שאומרים ברוך כו')

blocks.text: *Yetzira* is the world of speech: **already revealed worlds**, but still worlds that are half in and half out.

Yeshayahu saw the *Serafim*, who say "holy"; Yechezkel the *Chayos* and *Ofanim*, who say "blessed". All are in every world, but generally *Serafim* are in *Beriya*, *Chayos* in *Yetzira*, *Ofanim* in *Asiya*.

sections.title: The same in Yetzira and Asiya: the same existence, not the same essence
sections.summary: Everything said of the ten *sefiros* of *Beriya* holds in *Yetzira* and *Asiya*. This is easier to work out than it sounds, because the whole book was built on a man's own *chachma* and *bina*. Each world has the same parts, yet not the same essence, as a man's *chachma* in thought, speech and deed is the same *chachma* on different levels.

phrases.he: ועל דרך הנזכר לעיל בעשר ספירות דבריאה, כך הוא בעשר ספירות דיצירה ועשר ספירות דעשיה,
דרך פרטי פרטיות באורות וכלים ולבושים והיכלות כו',
והתהוות המלאכים ונשמות דיצירה הוא כמו סנדלפון
ודי למבין כו'

blocks.question: As in *Beriya*, so in *Yetzira* and *Asiya*: you told me about *Atzilus*, and now I should figure those out myself?
blocks.text: Not really. We never told you about *Atzilus*; we told you about *kelipos*: our own *chachma* and *bina*, from which we made three thousand *meshalim* upward. So *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are easier.

The *mashal* was an *Atzilus* of the *nefesh habahamis* (animal soul): *chachma* meant what is in my head, *mibsari echeze Eloka* (from my flesh I see G-d), and thought, speech and deed were ours. So it all holds in *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*.

blocks.question: If they are all the same, what is the difference?
blocks.text: The same *metzius* (existence), not the same *mahus* (essence): each has *chachma*, *bina* and angels, but *Beriya*'s angels are not *Asiya*'s, and its thought is not yours.

blocks.title: A man's essence, thought, speech and deed
blocks.text: A person's essence, his intellect and emotions, is like *Atzilus*; thought like *Beriya*, speech like *Yetzira*, deed like *Asiya*. Each has *chachma* and *bina*, but in thought they are finer than in speech, and certainly than in the deed.

blocks.title: Betzalel, a chacham of action
blocks.text: Even a deed has *chachma*: Betzalel was a *chacham* (wise man) of *Asiya*, who knew how to make nice things, but that is a whole different level.

The essence here is not the very essence, the *yechida*, but the *NaRaN* in brain, heart and liver: the essential *middos* in their vessels. Thought is a *yesh*, separate but hidden and very connected; speech half and half; the deed totally separate.
Think about this chapter a lot: go over it and see how all of this applies, and what *Beriya* really means.
The angels and souls of *Yetzira* come through *Sandalfon*. Places differ: some put *Metatron* in *Yetzira* and *Sandalfon* in *Asiya*; here *Metatron* is of *Beriya*, *Sandalfon* of *Yetzira*.

phrases.he: שכל נבואת הנביאים מבחינת נצח והוד דזעיר אנפין דיצירה כידוע

blocks.text: All prophecy is from *netzach* and *hod* of *Zeir Anpin* of *Yetzira*, except for Moshe, as a listener adds and he agrees.

sections.title: Asiya, down to the Ofanim and the constellations (not on tape)
sections.summary: In the same way a screen divides *Yetzira* from *Asiya*, and *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Yetzira* becomes the *Keser* of *Asiya*, down to its souls, angels, lower *Gan Eden* and *Ofanim*; from the dregs of the *Ofanim* come the roots of the constellations, which *Malchus* of *Malchus* of *Asiya* rules. The series has no recording of these lines.

reviewQuestions.question: Why is the will for the final deed not lower than the will to emanate, though it comes out of the *Malchus* of the world above it?
Why is the *Keser* of *Beriya* called *Keser Malchus*?
What is the difference between what separates *Atzilus* from the Essence and what separates *Beriya* from *Yetzira*?
How are *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* like thought, speech and deed?
If the whole book spoke of *Atzilus*, why is it easy to work out *Yetzira* and *Asiya* for oneself, and what is still different in each world?

notes.text: The class reads lines 1-8 quickly (w38-334), stops to sum up the chapter (w335-548), then goes back and rereads from line 1 (w549). The summing-up is placed under the passage of lines 4-8, whose content it describes, with outOfPlace; his first comment on Rabbi Yishmael (w238-265) is the second audio entry of the line 3 block.

Lines 27-31 have no recording. Class 230 ends with line 26 ("except for Moshe"); class 231 opens chapter 53 directly, saying only that the last thing before was the coming down to Malchus of Malchus of Asiya. The title and summary of the last section paraphrase the chapter text, not a class.

Almost every line is read in Hebrew without an English rendering; only the phrases where he gives one have en. The English of line 1's middle phrase, of line 3's two phrases, of the end of line 19 and of line 20 are his "in other words" glosses right after reading them; the line 3 rendering of "ברכני" is "help me come down", while in his first reading (w262-265) he says "Bless me".

Line 3: the Talmud's story (Berachos 7a) has G-d say to Rabbi Yishmael "Yishmael My son, bless Me"; he renders it "help me come down properly" and gives the answer as "May it be Your will that Your mercy overcome Your attributes, something like that". The block keeps his hesitation; the source is not added.

Line 16: the transcript has him read "אור החסד דבריאה" where the text has "אור הכתר דבריאה"; the block follows the line. He first says "the Malchus which is in the dibur" and corrects himself to "the bina which is in the dibur"; the block has the correction.

Lines 4-8: his reading has "ונקראין אבות דבריאה" (first reading) and "זו"ן" for the text's אבא ואמא and זעיר אנפין ונוקבה; the blocks follow the text (Abba and Ima, Zeir Anpin and Nukva), and keep his "Avos" only where he explains the earlier chapters.

Line 25: he says he has seen Metatron put in Yetzira and Sandalfon in Asiya, while "he" (the Mitteler Rebbe) puts Metatron in Beriya and Sandalfon in Yetzira; he says only "Sandal" and the transcript has "סנדל". A listener's "What do they call what?" (w2977-2980) is folded into the block.

Line 22: his question "But wait a minute, I thought the machshava comes out from the bina" gets an answer that breaks off at the end of w2212, before line 23 is read; the question block keeps only the part he said.
Line 26: "Except for Moshe" seems to be said by a listener, with his "Huh?" and then his agreement (w3024-3034); the block says so.
